description: Create a one-time link to upload one audio file (up to 100 MB), valid for 15 minutes. With a shell, upload with: curl -T "<file>" "<upload_url>". A person can instead open the link in a browser and choose the file. Then call transcribe_upload with the upload_id. The file is kept in memory only, until it is transcribed or the link expires.
name: create_upload_link
title: Create a one-time upload link
